Definition
[Homotopy equivalence and homotopy type]

↗ def:homotopy ↗ def:homotopic-maps

\group Homotopy Theory

A map $f:X\to Y$ is a homotopy equivalence if some $g:Y\to X$ satisfies $fg\simeq \one _Y$ and $gf\simeq \one _X$. In this case $X$ and $Y$ have the same homotopy type, written $X\simeq Y$.

Homotopy equivalence is an equivalence relation on spaces. Composites of homotopy equivalences are homotopy equivalences, and a map homotopic to a homotopy equivalence is itself a homotopy equivalence.
